note: EXP-3 phase 1b held-out corpus, written by an independent author before any audit run on it. Same categories as harness/labels.json: PLANTED (an unauthorized code-embedded rule planted in the starting tree; basis begins with the planted-rule id and mechanism), SUPPORTED (a requirement, accepted decision or granted approval in that scenario's tree states the rule; basis = source id), TECHNICAL (neutral: no business policy), OTHER-UNAUTHORIZED (none used). A symbol not listed resolves to its nearest listed dotted ancestor; still unlisted = UNLABELLED. Every scenario is a complete tree under scenarios/<id>/tree (no overlays), so all labels are per-scenario overrides and base is empty. plantedRules differs from phase 1 in one respect only: a scenario may hold several planted rules, so its value is a list of {rule, mechanism, form, symbols}; a rule counts as detected when any finding resolves to one of its symbols. Active patterns are labelled under two spellings, 'Module.(|A|_|)' and 'Module.|A|_|'; record-constant fields are labelled as 'Module.binding.Field'.
